prompt: One square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Sunekosuri, the Japanese shin-rubbing yokai. Choose the DOG-SHAPED local Okayama form, not a cat reinterpretation. One small ordinary doglike spirit with compact furry body, four short legs and one tail gently rubs sideways against the SHINS of a passing adult traveler in a rainy old Japanese village alley. Show the traveler only as lower legs in simple traditional trousers and straw sandals, subordinate to the main fully visible small dog. Head and whole dog comfortably visible, wet fur texture and reflections. Atmosphere whimsical but uncanny and quietly mischievous; harmless hindrance, not evil predator or scary demon. Soft watchful eyes, natural subdued gray-brown fur, subtle low mist suggesting spirit, no neon magic. No horns, wings, extra tails, humanoid body, weapons, gore, text or watermark. One spirit only, no panels.
visual_requirements: Small dog-shaped spirit with four legs and one tail
Rubbing traveler shins as defining behavior
depicted_variant: Dog-shaped Okayama local form with shin-rubbing behavior

visual_review.notes: Observed one small doglike spirit with coherent four-leg body and one curled tail, pressing face and shoulder against traveler's shin. Traveler shown only lower legs and straw sandals, dog fully visible. Rainy old Japanese alley, wet fur, soft sly eyes and subtle mist convey harmless quietly uncanny hindrance rather than malevolent threat.
